map.输入入射光频率（或波长）与金属功函数，工具按爱因斯坦方程计算光电子最大初动能，判: Enter the incident light frequency (or wavelength) and the metal work function; the tool applies Einstein's equation to compute the maximum initial kinetic energy of photoelectrons, judges whether the photoelectric effect occurs and gives the threshold frequency, for phototube and photovoltaic principle demonstrations.
map.K_max = hf − φ。 f 需 > φ/h 才逸出。: K_max = hf - phi. f must be greater than phi/h for electrons to escape.
map.光电子最大初动能等于光子能量减功函数。: The maximum initial kinetic energy of a photoelectron equals the photon energy minus the work function.
map.截止频率与逸出功判定。: Threshold frequency and work function determination.
map.：hf<Φ 时 K_max<0，无光电子 emission（与光强无关）。: When hf < Phi, K_max < 0 and no photoelectron emission occurs (regardless of light intensity).
map.由功率与波长求每秒光子数: Photons per Second from Power and Wavelength
map.光强影响动能吗？: Does light intensity affect kinetic energy?
map.不影响；只影响光电子数，动能由频率决定（爱因斯坦方程）。: No; it only affects the number of photoelectrons, while the kinetic energy is set by the frequency (Einstein's equation).
map.波粒二象性体现？: Where does wave-particle duality show up?
map.光子能量 E=hf 一次性交给电子，体现光的粒子性。: Photon energy E = hf is handed to an electron in one go, which shows the particle nature of light.
